1. Lobby & UI Systems
A. Main Lobby Hub
Design: A safe area floating in space with a futuristic design (Futuristic Floating Citadel).
Contents in the lobby:
Dungeon Portal: A major neon portal where players gather, containing a 10-second timer to start groups (Solo / Co-op up to 4 players).
Training Dummy Zone: An immortal combat dummy for testing damage (DPS Calculator).
Leaderboards: Three-dimensional screens displaying the highest-ranked players and the fastest time to complete puzzles.
B. HUD & UI Design
Main HUD:
Top left: A green health bar (HP), a blue energy/mana bar (Energy), and the level number (Level).
Top right: Currency display: Blue Crystals [free currency from gameplay] + Gold Essence [rare currency].
Bottom center: An Ability Bar displaying 4 slots for weapon skills and special abilities with cooldown time (Cooldown Cooldown Icons).
Top center: A compass/indicator directing the player toward the next puzzle or enemy location.
2. Menus & Shop System
A. In-Game Shop UI
The shop menu contains 3 main tabs:
Skins & Cosmetics:
Character Auras & Suits: (such as: the space neon skin, the steel guardian skin, the fire shadow skin). Changes the character's appearance and their foot effect while walking without giving an advantage (Cosmetic Only).
Weapon Skins: Glowing sword effects (such as: the flaming sword, the blue lightning sword).
Weapons & Upgrades:
Purchase and upgrade basic weapons using Blue Crystals (close-combat sword, speed dagger, area-damage hammer).
Consumables:
Health Potions, and temporary Speed Boosts.
B. Abilities & Skill Tree
Each player has 3 main abilities that can be equipped and upgraded:
Ability 1: Dash/Teleport: Allows the player to dash forward quickly and evade enemy attacks or puzzle traps (cooldown: 5 seconds).
Ability 2: Pulse Shield: An absorbent light shield for 3 seconds that reflects part of projectile damage (cooldown: 12 seconds).
Ability 3: Ultimate: Shockwave: Strike the ground forcefully to freeze all enemies in range for 3 seconds and solve puzzles dependent on rapid pressing (cooldown: 45 seconds).
3. Gameplay Map Details
Upon entering the portal, the player descends into the Crystal Citadel maze, which consists of 3 detailed areas:
Area One: Tower and Symbol Arena
Appearance: An enclosed arena with black stone walls and 4 colored crystal pillars.
Gameplay:
Spawn 20 guard monsters (Minion Bots).
Upon defeating them, a light signal appears on the wall in a color sequence.
Activating the buttons in the correct order opens the major portal and floods with gold and crystals.
Area Two: Laser Room and Moving Maze
Appearance: A floor of cubes with changing heights, with red laser beams moving horizontally and vertically.
Gameplay:
Use the Dash skill to evade the laser beams.
Find 3 three-dimensional energy keys hidden behind moving floor cubes and connect them to the central panel while fending off flying monsters.
Area Three: The Final Boss
Appearance: A very huge throne hall with a glass floor beneath which is neon volcanic lava.
Combat and puzzle method:
The boss is protected by an unbreakable energy wave.
On the ground are 4 illuminated Pressure Plates.
The player must lure the boss to stand on the illuminated circle, then strike it to activate a trap that drops the boss's shield for 6 seconds, where it can then be struck and dealt actual damage.
When the boss's health reaches 25%, it enters a "rage" state, its attack speed doubles, and jump and dodge timing must be highly precise.
4. System Mechanics
XP & Loot System:
Completing the map grants experience (XP) to raise the account level and rewards the player with 500 Blue Crystals.
Respawn & Checkpoints:
There are automatic save points (Checkpoints) at the beginning of each area. When the player dies, they are respawned at the previous save point without losing puzzle progress.
Audio & SFX:
Clear sounds for interacting with buttons and shops, distinctive sound effects for each skill, along with exciting music that changes according to the pace of combat.
